[image: Former State Senator Mia McLeod, J.D., led a seminar at a recent candidate training event I attended. Check out her memoir, The Unlikely Disruptor. I'm 64 pages in and loving it. So inspiring! https://tinyurl.com/MiaMcLeodMemoir]
[image: Have you seen Sharon Holden around town? Hmm, I wonder who she voted for?]
[image: I have marched, protested, called my elected officals, written postcards, phone banked, organized fundraisers, volunteered for candidates, canvassed and donated. And now ... I'm running!]
[image: I met Jumelle Brooks, candidate for SC House District 12, at the Day in Blue. She is the co-host of the podcast Black, White and Blue in the South. Check it out!]
[image: It's two of my GenZ voters from the Miles-Jamison precinct, and they're both Spann alum who became teachers! Thank you Carly & Heidi!]
[image: Less than 5 percent of District 94 early voters in the primary were between the ages of 18-24. Let's all encourage our young people to vote!]
